bitset_format: Little endian, index is mask of optional clue indices in the given order; all10 mandatory clues included.
proof: Every missing-mandatory subset inherits a validated alternative from full minus that clue. The remaining2^22 masks are partitioned exactly into supersets of777 independently DLX-certified unique puzzles and subsets of validated nonunique witnesses. The closures are disjoint and exhaustive. No trust in the subset-oracle search or its traversal is needed for completeness.
